# Implement the {{title}} prototype

Work in this package's source/ directory. Read source/AGENTS.md, project.config.json and source/{{skillPath}} first; the Codex adapter points to that same canonical skill. The project-preset package section takes precedence over the legacy Vue-only path.

## Implementation contract

This is a starting scaffold, NOT a completed prototype. Preserve shared src/core data and IDs, target-specific entrypoints, and the full Companion model in source/design/project.json and companion.project.json. The generated page-list projection is not a full rendering of visual definitions. Implement every agreed component, command, interaction, empty/failure/cancel state and recovery. Do not substitute Vue for vanilla or Angular, Nuxt server for Nuxt UI, or HTML for a CLI. Hybrid targets share code, not implicit remote state. Native host code must not leak into the shared core.

Use the selected adapters and generated source/scripts/build.mjs. Nuxt UI retains the repository version guards and owned CSS; Angular uses AOT, zoneless per-view application creation and cleanup; vanilla has no framework; CLI has real commands, structured stdout, stderr diagnostics and meaningful exit codes. No native activation, vault writes, deployment, push or provider access is authorized. Do not remove safeguards to make a build pass.

## Build and verification

Use the pinned Node/npm and declared dependencies. The root-only lockfile needs explicit npm install and review before clean npm ci is meaningful. Run npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run build. For browser/plugin previews use npm run build:prototype to produce source/dist/prototype.html with bundled libraries, scoped CSS, license notices and complete embedded model; no CDN, remote imports, external fonts or fabricated readiness. For CLI use npm run start:cli and test real transcripts, failure exit codes and JSON-only stdout; there is no HTML deliverable. Hybrid needs acceptance on every selected target.

Run real artifact browser/offline tests for visual targets, keyboard/focus and narrow/wide layouts, invalid data and cleanup. Native Obsidian acceptance requires a separately authorized disposable vault. Add business acceptance tests; the starting scaffold checks do not prove business behavior. Keep source below 400 and tests below 450 code lines, excluding blanks/comments. Retain existing quality thresholds where applicable.

Record exact commands, logs and not-run boundaries. Deliver the agreed prototype artifacts, source, complete Companion JSON, brief and integration map. Replace null hashes and incomplete status only after measuring real built artifacts and verifying the journeys. Retain default-No overwrite/review semantics. Use real subagents when available; otherwise report sequential work honestly.

# {{title}} — project prototype preparation

This package contains the agreed selection/brief, execution-prompt.md, a complete Companion v6 document and independently buildable source. It is NOT a completed prototype. Start with execution-prompt.md.

project.config.json records the target/framework outside the Companion envelope. source/project.config.json is the same selection. project-request.json is the exact replay request for `node bin/app new --input <request> --out <folder> --json`; review its plan before --apply. The exact guide is retained in prototype-guide.json.

See source/README.md for target-specific dependency resolution/build commands. Dependencies, builds, business acceptance and native activation were not performed by preparation.

# Integration boundaries

The complete importable model is companion.project.json, mirrored in source/design/project.json. Stable IDs originate from the shared compiler. project.config.json is a separate versioned selection, never additional envelope fields.

The target adapter creates a navigable page-list scaffold and host lifecycle, not arbitrary visual/component/business execution. Source-owned implementation and component behavior must be documented in integration-map.json; do not claim arbitrary source round-trips into JSON. Read source/design/compiler-readiness.json and prototype.acceptance.json for incomplete work.
